C1209.title: Nicholas Truglia Sentenced for Theft of More Than $20 Million in Cryptocurrency via SIM Swap Attack
C1209.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice said Nicholas Truglia was sentenced in the Southern District of New York to 18 months in prison for participating in a SIM swap scheme that stole more than $20 million worth of cryptocurrency from a victim. He was also ordered to pay $20,379,007 in restitution within 60 days. The case shows how hijacking a phone number can bypass SMS-based two-factor authentication and enable account takeover of digital assets.
